model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the negative probability log terms for various models fine-tuned on specific medical specialties. The horizontal axis represents per-specialty terms, with categories listed alphabetically as “Cardio,” “Gastro,” “Infect,” “Neuro,” “Obstetrics,” and “Pediatrics.” The vertical axis displays “Negative probability log probability,” with a scale ranging from -27 to -22, marked with tick labels in increments of 1. The bars are colored by model, with “Cardio” represented by brown bars that fluctuate between -23.5 and -25.8, “Gastro” represented by orange bars that fluctuate between -24.1 and -25.9, “Infect” represented by pink bars that fluctuate between -24.9 and -25.7, “Neuro” represented by dark gray bars that fluctuate between -23.5 and -25.2, “Obstetrics” represented by light brown bars that fluctuate between -24.8 and -25.6, and “Pediatrics” represented by light blue bars that fluctuate between -24.3 and -25.2. All bars are unsorted, and no bars are visually emphasized.
